|---|---|---:|
| Person | `https://schema.org/Person` | 4 |
| AgriParcel | `https://smartdatamodels.org/dataModel.Agrifood/AgriParcel` | 6 |
| Animal | `https://smartdatamodels.org/dataModel.Agrifood/Animal` | 47 |
| Building | `https://smartdatamodels.org/dataModel.Building/Building` | 4 |

Observed entity IDs:

- **Person:** `urn:ngsi-ld:Person:person001`, `urn:ngsi-ld:Person:person002`, `urn:ngsi-ld:Person:person003`, `urn:ngsi-ld:Person:person004`.
- **AgriParcel:** `urn:ngsi-ld:AgriParcel:001`, `urn:ngsi-ld:AgriParcel:002`, `urn:ngsi-ld:AgriParcel:003`, `urn:ngsi-ld:AgriParcel:004`, `urn:ngsi-ld:AgriParcel:005`, `urn:ngsi-ld:AgriParcel:006`.
- **Animal:** `urn:ngsi-ld:Animal:cow001` through `urn:ngsi-ld:Animal:cow040` inclusive; `urn:ngsi-ld:Animal:cow101`, `urn:ngsi-ld:Animal:cow102`, `urn:ngsi-ld:Animal:cow103`; and `urn:ngsi-ld:Animal:pig001` through `urn:ngsi-ld:Animal:pig004` inclusive. These ranges abbreviate the individually returned IDs.

Discovery used `get_broker_info({})`, then `get_types({"limit":100,"offset":0})`, which returned the four types and their observed attributes, including `name`. Counts were verified with one `query_entities` call per exact type ID above, using:

```json
{"type":"<exact type ID>","attrs":["name"],"limit":100,"offset":0,"representation":"normalized"}
```

All calls succeeded with HTTP 200. Each count matched both the returned entity count and broker-reported total. Every page reported `has_more=false` and `incomplete=false`; no further pagination was needed.

Scope: these are broker-wide counts, with no farm-specific filter. No relationship traversal was needed for this inventory. Counts use the unit **entities**; no physical measurement units apply. No errors occurred.

| `VocabProperty` | `healthCondition`, `phenologicalCondition`, `reproductiveCondition`, `sex` |
| `Relationship` | `calvedBy`, `locatedAt`, `ownedBy`, `siredBy` |
| `GeoProperty` | `location` |

Thus, **`locatedAt` links to another entity; `location` stores geographic geometry**. Despite its name, `fedWith` is stored as a `Property`, not a relationship.

Representative observed values for **`urn:ngsi-ld:Animal:cow001`**:

| Attribute | Exact stored value |
|---|---|
| `birthdate` | `2021-08-21T00:00:00.000Z` |

| `sex` | vocab `Male` |
| `phenologicalCondition` | vocab `maleAdult` |
| `reproductiveCondition` | vocab `active` |
| `location` | GeoJSON `Point`, coordinates `[13.15,52.228]`; observedAt `2024-02-02T15:00:00.000Z` |

The remaining vocabulary attribute, `healthCondition`, is observed as vocab **`healthy`** on **`urn:ngsi-ld:Animal:cow006`**, observedAt `2024-02-02T15:00:00.000Z`. Unit codes above are reproduced as returned; no unit expansion is assumed.

All distinct direct Animal relationship targets were read:

| Relationship | Observed targets and verification |
|---|---|
| `calvedBy` | `urn:ngsi-ld:Animal:cow101` → `urn:ngsi-ld:Animal:cow002` (“Trotter”); `urn:ngsi-ld:Animal:cow102` → `urn:ngsi-ld:Animal:cow004` (“River”); `urn:ngsi-ld:Animal:cow103` → `urn:ngsi-ld:Animal:cow006` (“Twilight”). All targets exist. |
| `siredBy` | All three calves above → `urn:ngsi-ld:Animal:cow001` (“Beany”), which exists. |
| `locatedAt` | Existing targets: `urn:ngsi-ld:AgriParcel:003` (“North Pasture”), `urn:ngsi-ld:AgriParcel:004` (“East Pasture”), `urn:ngsi-ld:AgriParcel:005` (“Water Meadow”), `urn:ngsi-ld:AgriParcel:006` (“The Paddock”), and `urn:ngsi-ld:Building:barn002` (“Big Red Barn”). |
| `ownedBy` | Existing targets: `urn:ngsi-ld:Person:person001` (“Old MacDonald”) and `urn:ngsi-ld:Person:person002` (“Napoleon the Pig”). The actual target `urn:ngsi-ld:Person:001`, used by `urn:ngsi-ld:Animal:cow006`, `urn:ngsi-ld:Animal:cow102`, and `urn:ngsi-ld:Animal:cow103`, returned **HTTP 404**, `ResourceNotFound`, “Entity Not Found”. Read calls and scope:

- `get_entity({"entity_id":<each exact target listed above>,"representation":"normalized"})` — 11 successful target reads and the one 404 described above.

No filters, attribute projection, or context override were supplied. These are facts about currently stored observations, **not a complete model schema or a claim that every Animal has every attribute**.
